The full amplifier is shown
in this slide. The three stages
are used to increase the gain,
yielding very low distortion.
The first and second
stages are symmetrical
amplifiers. The third stage
consists of two output
devices with the quiescent-
current control described in
the previous slide. Nested
Miller compensation is
used.
Its GBW is 5 MHz. It
gives only −80 dB THD at
10 kHz in 81 V in parallel
with 15 pF. The quiescent
current is 1.4 mA.
